name: AI Feeds
author: Borja Abad

sections.description:
AI Feeds allows you to manage and process RSS feeds by automatically enriching content through Artificial Intelligence. It transforms standard RSS entries into SEO-optimized articles with images, enhanced headlines, tags, intelligent categories, and more.

This plugin is ready for translation at translate.wordpress.org. Contribute your translation!

Main features:

  • Smart Connection to OpenAI

    • Use the cibeles.net provided service or directly connect your own OpenAI APIKEY.
    • Clearly monitor the available word count in real-time.

  • Advanced global or per-feed configuration

    • Set specific configurations per RSS source or use general configurations applicable to all your feeds.

  • Automatic content generation

    • Automatically generate subtitles, pre-titles, summaries, tags, and more.
    • Automatically categorize entries based on content context using AI.

  • Full prompt customization

    • Complete control over the instructions sent to the AI for generating unique content tailored to your audience.

  • Automated SEO optimization

    • Full integration with Yoast SEO.
    • Automatic generation of optimized keywords, titles, and meta descriptions.

  • Advanced link processing

    • Automatically remove links from content if desired.
    • Automatically convert links to “nofollow”.

  • Easy Import tool

    • Automatic or manual processing queue based on your preference.
    • Intelligent import with preview and the option to halt automatic processing.

  • Scheduled or immediate publishing

    • Choose to publish entries immediately or schedule them.

  • Efficient image management

    • Automatic download of featured and relevant images.
    • Automatic adjustment of images in imported articles.

  • Clear and detailed history

    • Access the history of generated and imported content.

  • Integration with comunicae.es

    • Boost the reach and visibility of your AI-generated content thanks to the exclusive integration with Comunicae, the leading platform for press release dissemination.

AI Feeds significantly optimizes the WordPress workflow, enabling the transformation of standard RSS content into enriched, automatically adapted articles for better results and increased visibility.

External Services

This plugin uses external services to provide functionalities related to the management and automated content generation through Artificial Intelligence.

1. Cibeles.net

What is it and what is it used for?
It is a service provided by Cibeles.net that offers updated lists of public RSS feeds available in the Cibeles Library, as well as tags associated with these feeds. The plugin uses this data to provide predefined options for users in the plugin’s interface.

What data is sent and when?
No user data is sent to this service. Only HTTP GET requests without sensitive information are performed each time the user views the available list of feeds or tags.

Example URL used:
https://cibeles.net/get_feeds.php

Important links:
– Terms and Conditions of Cibeles.net
– Privacy Policy of Cibeles.net

2. openai.editmaker.com

What is it and what is it used for?
It is an intermediate server provided by Editmaker.com that connects with the official OpenAI API to automatically generate content (headlines, summaries, categories, tags, etc.) using artificial intelligence (GPT-4 and similar models).

What data is sent and when?
The plugin sends RSS feed content and specific user settings each time automated content is generated. This data includes:

  • Title (title)
  • Short description (description)
  • Full feed content (content)
  • Original feed link (link)
  • Original publication date of the feed
  • Categories in JSON format
  • User settings (custom prompts, specific plugin settings)
  • OpenAI API Key (only if the user provides it in the plugin settings; it is never stored on the intermediate server)

Example URL used:
https://openai.editmaker.com/wp/api/endpoints_aifeeds.php

Important links:
– Editmaker Terms and Conditions
– Editmaker Privacy Policy

3. Official OpenAI API

What is it and what is it used for?
If users enter their own official OpenAI API Key in the plugin settings, this key is used to communicate directly with the official OpenAI API via Editmaker’s intermediate server, allowing content generation using models such as GPT-4.

What data is sent and when?
The same data listed above is sent to OpenAI’s servers, including the API Key provided by the user. This key is only used for individual requests and is never stored permanently.

Important links:
– OpenAI Terms of Use
– OpenAI Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access AI Feeds from the side menu and configure your RSS sources and general preferences.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI account?

Not necessarily; you can directly use the connection provided by cibeles.net, starting with 200,000 free words.

How do I obtain my own OpenAI APIKEY?

You can get your APIKEY directly from OpenAI.

Can I customize the AI-generated content?

Yes, you can fully customize the prompts sent to the AI, allowing detailed control over the style and generated content.
